description: This file defines the internal class 'ValueTypeSerializerFactory' responsible for creating serializer instances for value types within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It manages caching and reflection-based creation of serializers for struct types.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and caching serializers for value types (structs) in the Orleans serialization system.

methods.name: GetSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a serializer for the specified value type, utilizing a cache for reuse.

methods.name: CreateTypedSerializer
methods.description: Creates a serializer for a specific value type via reflection and generics, and is invoked internally.
